_notes: Each respondent = one full TROG run = one cell (model x age x repeat). 3 x 4 x 4 = 48 respondents. Ability is varied only on the responder side (model strength + child-age IRT persona); the stimulus is never altered. temperature>0 + repeats give within-cell variance so identical cells are not deterministic duplicates. Tune `repeats`/`models`/`ages` to trade compute for panel size. If the low-ability tail is thin (spread gate fails in analyze.mjs), add weaker/older Gemini snapshots here -- never degrade the input.
